title: 機械工学専門実験・演習A
subtitle: Mechanical Engineering Major Lab/ Exercises A
keywords: Thermodynamics and Fluid mechanics 2.Mechanics of materials 3.Vibration engineering 4.Materials Science 5.Molding and plastic processing
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Acquire sufficient understanding and application of specialized subjects, such as thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, mechanics of materials, vibration engineering, materials Science, and molding and plastic processing. (2) Acquire technical writing skills. (3) Learn how to create presentation materials and presentation scripts.
advice: We will cover the following topics: Thermodynamics: temperature measurement, heat pump, and coefficient of performance Internal combustion engine: thermal efficiency, emissions, and diesel cycle Fluid mechanics: flow rate, friction factor, and flow around circular cylinders Mechanics of materials: tensile tests and bending tests Vibration engineering: vibration measurement methods, dynamic vibration systems, and dynamic absorbers Materials Science: Observation of microstructure and hardness testing Molding and plastic processing: deep drawing, injection molding, and formability Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class. Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.
books: Textbooks: Mechanical Engineering Major Lab/Exercises, Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese) Reference books: Reserved books:
requiredKnowledge: Preview and review related specialized subjects. Create and submit technical preparatory reports before each experimental class. Have basic knowledge of related specialized subjects. Know how to use a calculator and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).

activityGoals.body: Be able to summarize experimental results.
Be able to actively participate in experiments based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to consider the experimental results based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to evaluate the experimental results based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to use the kinematics model to determine the relationship between experimental and theoretical results.
Be able to submit and explain your experimental results as a technical report.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Create thorough technical reports on experimental results using a computer. (2) Proactively participate systematically in class experiments based on the related specialized subjects. (3) Consider and evaluate the experimental results according to the related specialized subjects. (4) Use the kinematics model to compare experimental and theoretical results. (5) Explain the experimental results in a thorough technical report and submit it for evaluation.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Create technical reports on experimental results using a computer. (2) Participate the class experiments based on the related specialized subjects. (3) Consider and evaluate the experimental results according to the related specialized subjects. (4) Compare the relationship between experimental and theoretical results. (5) Explain the experimental results in a technical report and submit it for evaluation.

lessons.content: Guidance Learn about how to attend each experiment, how to create a report, and safety guidelines.
lessons.assignments: (Preparation) Check the guidance materials (Review) Confirmation of attendance for each experiment, report creation method, and safety guidelines

lessons.content: Experiments in thermodynamics (1) Perform a heat pump performance test using a thermocouple.
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in thermodynamics (2) Perform a heat pump performance test using a radiation thermometer.
Experiments in fluid mechanics (1) Measurements of flow rate and friction loss in a pipe Measurement of drag acting on a circular cylinder
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in fluid mechanics (2) Experiment to change the drag acting on a circul ar cylinder
Experiments in mechanics of materials (1) Tensile tests for steel, aluminum, and carbon fiber-reinforced plastics
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in mechanics of materials (2) Three-point bending tests for steel, aluminum, and carbon fiber-reinforced plastics
Factory tour and company research Learn about the relationship between manufacturing and engineering in a company.
lessons.assignments: (Preparation) Browse the home page of the specified company and understand the products that are manufactured and sold. (Review) A report on the relationship between manufacturing and engineering in companies.

lessons.content: Experiments in vibration engineering (1) Vibration measurement using piezoelectric vibration sensor and eddy current displacement sensor
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in vibration engineering (2) Dynamic vibration system using dynamic absorber

Experiments in materials science (1) Conduct hardness testing and optical microscope observation of metals for a machine structure. Discuss the relationship between macrostructure, hardness, and heat treatment.
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in materials science (2) Discussion for the experiments based on the 1st technical reports. Point out the corrections in the 1st technical reports. Self-check Review the content learned in the experiment, self-check the final report, and use it for future study planning.
lessons.operation: Lecture, experimental activities, and Q&A Self-check and self- reflection

lessons.content: Experiments in molding and plastic processing (1) Injection molding tests to understand the influence of molding conditions using polymer materials
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in molding and plastic processing (2) Deep drawing tests to understand material properties and the processing limits for steel and aluminum

lessons.assignments: Review items that are not yet fully understood.
